data.name: Shadow Magic
data.description: Wayangs add 1 to the DC of any saving throws to resist spells of the shadow subschool that they cast. Wayangs with a Charisma score of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day--ghost sound, pass without trace, and ventriloquism. The caster level for these effects is equal to the wayang's character level. The DCs of these spells are equal to 10 + the spell's level + the wayang's Charisma modifier.
